selection: Aircraft messages received by exactly five sensors described by the source as GPS timed.
limitations: This is a historical filtered extract and is not live data.
The compact source contains pre-grouped observations rather than original Mode-S frames.
The source describes the selected sensors as GPS timed but does not provide per-observation clock uncertainty.
Ground truth is aircraft-reported ADS-B position, not an independent survey measurement.
Dataset-local receiver serials are not CKB Registry identities and do not prove receiver ownership.
